tagline: Network join karte hi device ko IP address kaise milta hai.
description: Naya device jis network mein aaya hai, uske baare mein kuch nahi jaanta: na apna address, na router, na DNS server. DHCP yeh problem chaar messages (Discover, Offer, Request, Ack) mein solve karta hai, phir device ek fixed time ke liye address rent par leta hai aur khatam hone se pehle renew karta hai.

normal.name: Network join karna (DORA) aur renew karna
normal.summary: Laptop plug in hota hai, chaar messages mein 192.168.1.10 paata hai, aur lease ke beech mein renew karta hai.

steps.title: DISCOVER
steps.detail: Laptop ke paas IP address nahi hai aur use server ka pata bhi nahi, isliye woh chillata hai. Woh 0.0.0.0 se 255.255.255.255 ko bhejta hai, ff:ff:ff:ff:ff:ff wale Ethernet frame ke andar, taaki network ka har device sun le. Woh ek random transaction ID chunta hai taaki replies ko is request se match kar sake.

quiz.q: Laptop 0.0.0.0 address se kyun bhejta hai?
options: Abhi uske paas IP address nahi hai
quiz.why: 0.0.0.0 ka matlab hai “yeh host, abhi address nahi”. Message ke andar ka MAC address server ko batata hai ki kaun puch raha hai.

steps.title: OFFER
steps.desc: Server ek address suggest karta hai
steps.detail: Home router ek chhota DHCP server chalata hai. Woh apne pool se ek free address 192.168.1.10 chunta hai aur subnet mask, gateway, ek DNS server aur lease time ke saath offer karta hai. Laptop ne broadcast reply maanga tha (uske paas unicast receive karne ke liye address nahi hai), isliye offer bhi broadcast hota hai.

quiz.q: OFFER 255.255.255.255 ko bheja jata hai. Seedha 192.168.1.10 ko kyun nahi?
options: Laptop ke paas abhi woh address nahi hai aur usne broadcast flag set kiya
quiz.why: Address sirf offer hua hai, confirm nahi, aur laptop ne broadcast replies maange kyunki uska IP stack abhi configured nahi hai.

steps.title: REQUEST
steps.desc: “Haan please, yeh wala main le lunga”
steps.detail: Laptop ek REQUEST broadcast karke accept karta hai, jisme woh address (option 50) aur chuna hua server (option 54) likha hota hai. Yeh broadcast isliye hai ki agar kai servers ne offer diye the, to baaki dekh lein ki unhe nahi chuna gaya aur apne addresses pool mein wapas daal dein.

quiz.q: Laptop server ko jaanta hai, phir REQUEST broadcast kyun hota hai?
options: Baaki servers ko batane ke liye ki unke offers decline hue
Kyunki UDP mein unicast nahi hota
Aisa nahi hai; yeh 192.168.1.1 ko jata hai
quiz.why: Har server REQUEST sunta hai aur option 54 dekhta hai. Sirf named server jawab deta hai; baaki apne offered addresses free kar dete hain.

steps.title: ACK
steps.detail: Server lease ko apni table mein likhta hai aur ACK se confirm karta hai. Ab jaake laptop 192.168.1.10/24 configure karta hai, 192.168.1.1 ko default gateway set karta hai aur DNS ke liye use karta hai. Kai systems phir ek quick ARP check bhejte hain ki address par koi aur toh nahi hai.

steps.title: T1 par Renew
steps.desc: Lease ke beech mein, extend karne ko kaho
steps.detail: Baarah ghante baad (T1, aadhi lease) laptop apna address rakhne ko kehta hai. Ab uske paas working address hai aur server pata hai, isliye REQUEST seedha 192.168.1.1 ko jata hai aur ciaddr field mein uska apna address hota hai. Server naya ACK deta hai aur 24 ghante ki clock phir se shuru hoti hai. Agar server T2 tak chup rehta, to laptop kisi bhi server ko broadcast karta.

quiz.q: Baarah ghante baad renewal REQUEST kaise address hoga?
options: Bheja hi nahi jata; leases khud renew hoti hain
quiz.why: Laptop ke paas ab valid address hai aur server pata hai, isliye woh seedha usse baat kar sakta hai.

outro.title: Configured aur renewed
outro.text: Chaar broadcasts aur replies (Discover, Offer, Request, Ack) ne laptop ko address, gateway aur DNS server de diya. Lease ke beech mein usne do chhote unicast messages se renew kiya, isliye address kabhi khatam nahi hua.

no-server.name: DHCP server nahi hai (APIPA 169.254.x.x)
no-server.summary: DISCOVER ka koi jawab nahi deta, to laptop khud ko link-local address deta hai jo sirf local wire par chalta hai.

steps.title: DISCOVER, koi jawab nahi
steps.desc: Awaaz ka koi jawab nahi aata
steps.detail: Router ki DHCP service band ho gayi hai (ya crash). DISCOVER network ke har device tak pahunchta hai, lekin port 67 par koi sun nahi raha, isliye kuch wapas nahi aata.

steps.title: Phir try karo, zyada wait karo
steps.detail: DHCP UDP par chalta hai, jisme delivery guarantee nahi, isliye client apni retries khud karta hai. Woh attempts ke beech lagbhag 4, phir 8, phir 16 seconds wait karta hai (thodi randomness ke saath). Seconds-elapsed field har baar badhta hai taaki server dekh sake ki client kitni der se wait kar raha hai.

quiz.q: Har fail attempt ke baad waiting time double kyun hota hai?
options: Busy network ko broadcasts se flood hone se bachane ke liye
quiz.why: Backoff se sainkdon devices network par broadcasts ki bauchhar nahi karte jab server slow ya missing ho.

steps.title: 169.254 address chuno
steps.desc: APIPA: random chuno, pehle check karo
steps.detail: Lagbhag ek minute baad laptop haar maan leta hai aur 169.254.0.0/16 mein ek random link-local address chunta hai (Windows ise APIPA kehta hai). Use karne se pehle woh 0.0.0.0 se ARP probes bhejta hai ki kya 169.254.37.112 pehle se kisi ke paas hai. Chuppi ka matlab address free hai.

quiz.q: Laptop address check karte waqt ARP probe ka sender IP kya hota hai?
quiz.why: Laptop ko address claim nahi karna chahiye jab tak pata na ho ki woh free hai, isliye probe ka sender IP 0.0.0.0 hota hai.

steps.title: Announce karo aur usi ke saath jiyo
steps.desc: Address sirf is wire par chalta hai
steps.detail: Kisi ne jawab nahi diya, to laptop gratuitous ARP se address announce karta hai aur use karna shuru karta hai. Woh usi switch ke un devices se baat kar sakta hai jinke paas bhi 169.254 addresses hain, lekin gateway aur DNS nahi hai, isliye internet unreachable hai. 169.254 address dikhna DHCP fail hone ki classic nishani hai.

outro.title: Self-assigned, lekin atka hua
outro.text: DHCP server nahi hone par laptop ne self-assigned 169.254 address le liya. Woh background mein DISCOVERs bhejta rehta hai, aur jaise hi koi server jawab deta hai woh proper address par switch ho jata hai.
facts: DHCP server, cable ya Wi-Fi check karo

rogue.name: Rogue DHCP server aur DHCP snooping
rogue.summary: Attacker asli router se pehle jawab deta hai aur khud gateway ban jata hai; switch par DHCP snooping use block karti hai.

steps.title: DISCOVER sabko pahunchta hai
steps.detail: Broadcast switch ke har port par jata hai. Jo attacker network mein laptop (ya sasta router) laga deta hai, woh DISCOVER ko waise hi dekhta hai jaise asli server. DHCP mein yeh prove karne ka koi built-in tareeka nahi ki kaunsa server genuine hai.

steps.title: Rogue pehle jawab deta hai
steps.desc: Fake gateway ke saath fake offer
steps.detail: Attacker ka server ek millisecond ke andar, asli router se pehle jawab deta hai. Uska offer normal dikhta hai, lekin usme attacker ki apni machine default gateway aur DNS server dono ke roop mein likhi hoti hai. Clients aam taur par pehla mila hua offer le lete hain.

quiz.q: Agar laptop yeh offer accept kar le, to internet ka traffic pehle kahan jayega?
quiz.why: Default gateway option laptop ko batata hai ki local network ke bahar sab kuch kahan bhejna hai. Yahan woh attacker hai.

steps.title: Laptop jaal mein fas jata hai
steps.desc: Traffic ab attacker se hoke jata hai
steps.detail: Laptop rogue offer ko request karta hai aur ACK paata hai. Ab internet ki taraf jane wala har packet pehle attacker ke paas jata hai, aur har DNS lookup ka jawab attacker deta hai, jo victim ko fake websites par bhej sakta hai. Yeh man-in-the-middle position hai.

steps.title: Defence: DHCP snooping
steps.desc: Switch sirf router ke port par bharosa karta hai
steps.detail: DHCP snooping on hone par switch asli router wale port ko trusted aur baaki sab ports ko untrusted mark karta hai. Untrusted port par aane wale server messages (OFFER, ACK) drop ho jate hain, isliye rogue offer laptop tak nahi pahunchta. Switch yeh bhi record karta hai ki kis MAC ko kaunsa IP mila, jo baad mein ARP spoofing block karne mein madad karta hai.
facts: ARP inspection ke liye binding table

quiz.q: Untrusted mark kiye gaye switch port par DHCP OFFER aata hai. Snooping kya karti hai?
quiz.why: Sirf trusted ports server messages le ja sakte hain. Clients ko kabhi OFFER ya ACK bhejna nahi padta, isliye unhe drop karna safe hai.

outro.title: Sirf asli server hi pass hota hai
outro.text: DHCP usi par bharosa karta hai jo pehle jawab de, isliye rogue server sabka gateway banne ka aasan tareeka hai. Managed switches par DHCP snooping un ports se server messages rok deti hai jahan sirf clients hone chahiye.
facts: Attacker gateway aur DNS ban jata hai

cheatsheet.title: Message types (option 53)
items: Client accept ya renew karta hai
Server mana karta hai (galat subnet, purana address)
